description: Create a progress-report room (owned by the human who authorized you) and bind this directory to it. Requires a prior concord_authorize. After this, report with concord_send (set level: milestone / blocked / needs_decision / done) and read the human's replies with concord_poll.

name.description: Short, human-meaningful title for what you are reporting on, e.g. "Auth module refactor". A 📊 prefix is added automatically.

purpose.description: Optional one-line description of the task you are reporting on.

sender.description: Your display name in the room. Defaults to "reporter".

name: concord_report
